name: webmcp-extension
description: Control any WebMCP-enabled website using your own Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI API key.

scripts.copy: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp src/background.js src/content.js src/page-bridge.js src/sidepanel.html src/sidepanel.css dist/ && cp -r icons dist/
scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run copy && npm run package
scripts.watch: npm run copy && npm run bundle -- --watch
